problem_text:
A farm is planning to cultivate 10 distinct varieties of a specialty crop, each of which must undergo 10 sequential cultivation stages to be fully ready for harvest.  
The revenue generated per hectare for each crop variety is specified as follows:  
* For Variety Alpha, revenue is 15.46 per hectare  
* For Variety Beta, revenue is 10.857 per hectare  
* For Variety Gamma, revenue is 15.508 per hectare  
* For Variety Delta, revenue is 16.124 per hectare  
* For Variety Epsilon, revenue is 17.132 per hectare  
* For Variety Zeta, revenue is 5.723 per hectare  
* For Variety Eta, revenue is 9.601 per hectare  
* For Variety Theta, revenue is 13.745 per hectare  
* For Variety Iota, revenue is 14.993 per hectare  
* For Variety Kappa, revenue is 13.946 per hectare  

The cultivation time required per hectare for each stage is detailed below:  
*For Variety Alpha, Stage 1 requires 1.645 (hectare-hours), Stage 2 requires 0.798, Stage 3 requires 1.352, Stage 4 requires 1.159, Stage 5 requires 1.716, Stage 6 requires 0.738, Stage 7 requires 1.162, Stage 8 requires 0.627, Stage 9 requires 1.864, Stage 10 requires 1.933  
*For Variety Beta, Stage 1 requires 0.747, Stage 2 requires 1.753, Stage 3 requires 0.982, Stage 4 requires 0.726, Stage 5 requires 0.885, Stage 6 requires 1.538, Stage 7 requires 1.971, Stage 8 requires 1.695, Stage 9 requires 1.718, Stage 10 requires 0.746  
*For Variety Gamma, Stage 1 requires 0.551, Stage 2 requires 0.637, Stage 3 requires 1.897, Stage 4 requires 0.495, Stage 5 requires 0.583, Stage 6 requires 1.629, Stage 7 requires 1.761, Stage 8 requires 0.641, Stage 9 requires 1.141, Stage 10 requires 0.856  
*For Variety Delta, Stage 1 requires 1.754, Stage 2 requires 1.254, Stage 3 requires 1.058, Stage 4 requires 1.423, Stage 5 requires 1.973, Stage 6 requires 1.35, Stage 7 requires 1.655, Stage 8 requires 1.661, Stage 9 requires 0.677, Stage 10 requires 0.902  
*For Variety Epsilon, Stage 1 requires 0.558, Stage 2 requires 1.287, Stage 3 requires 1.616, Stage 4 requires 0.949, Stage 5 requires 0.8, Stage 6 requires 0.969, Stage 7 requires 1.499, Stage 8 requires 0.273, Stage 9 requires 1.864, Stage 10 requires 1.39  
*For Variety Zeta, Stage 1 requires 1.231, Stage 2 requires 0.226, Stage 3 requires 0.355, Stage 4 requires 0.472, Stage 5 requires 1.31, Stage 6 requires 1.207, Stage 7 requires 0.496, Stage 8 requires 1.747, Stage 9 requires 0.798, Stage 10 requires 0.452  
*For Variety Eta, Stage 1 requires 0.725, Stage 2 requires 1.552, Stage 3 requires 1.076, Stage 4 requires 1.348, Stage 5 requires 0.685, Stage 6 requires 1.316, Stage 7 requires 0.644, Stage 8 requires 0.224, Stage 9 requires 1.491, Stage 10 requires 0.995  
*For Variety Theta, Stage 1 requires 0.743, Stage 2 requires 1.147, Stage 3 requires 0.886, Stage 4 requires 1.654, Stage 5 requires 1.947, Stage 6 requires 1.374, Stage 7 requires 0.269, Stage 8 requires 1.377, Stage 9 requires 0.217, Stage 10 requires 0.919  
*For Variety Iota, Stage 1 requires 0.365, Stage 2 requires 1.754, Stage 3 requires 0.247, Stage 4 requires 1.42, Stage 5 requires 1.032, Stage 6 requires 1.116, Stage 7 requires 0.666, Stage 8 requires 0.879, Stage 9 requires 0.979, Stage 10 requires 1.01  
*For Variety Kappa, Stage 1 requires 1.079, Stage 2 requires 1.703, Stage 3 requires 1.336, Stage 4 requires 1.749, Stage 5 requires 1.128, Stage 6 requires 1.142, Stage 7 requires 1.332, Stage 8 requires 1.482, Stage 9 requires 1.522, Stage 10 requires 1.206  

* The total cultivation time allocated to Stage 1 cannot surpass 114.384 hours  
* The total cultivation time allocated to Stage 2 cannot surpass 172.514 hours  
* The total cultivation time allocated to Stage 3 cannot surpass 111.357 hours  
* The total cultivation time allocated to Stage 4 cannot surpass 156.525 hours  
* The total cultivation time allocated to Stage 5 cannot surpass 168.304 hours  
* The total cultivation time allocated to Stage 6 cannot surpass 147.413 hours  
* The total cultivation time allocated to Stage 7 cannot surpass 160.355 hours  
* The total cultivation time allocated to Stage 8 cannot surpass 135.833 hours  
* The total cultivation time allocated to Stage 9 cannot surpass 139.433 hours  
* The total cultivation time allocated to Stage 10 cannot surpass 150.376 hours  

Given that the cumulative cultivation time for each individual stage—Stage 1 through Stage 10—must remain within its respective available time allotment, determine the optimal allocation of land to each crop variety in order to maximize the farm’s total revenue.
